description: Go baseline compared with actual Hono factory registrations. Main means an optional dependency is supplied in main.ts with its feature configuration enabled, not live availability or verified behavior. Named HTTP SDK coverage is not whole-server parity.
baseline: test/contract/http/app/routes.golden; TestRouteInventory checked separately. Conditional mounts excluded by that fixture remain in go-inventory.json and the explicit review list below.

nativeStartupWorkers.limitation: Most workers require explicit feature flags and configuration. A matching worker name does not establish legacy job ownership handover or complete service behavior.

additionalStartup.remaining: Native boot must require complete migration history and an appropriate runtime role; no database worker is started here.
Realtime listener/hub and compatible HTTP/WebSocket delivery remain unported.
Shared persisted abuse blocks and refresh behavior require an owner; current native local rate limits are not this feature.
Existing domain gauges, protected metrics endpoint and shutdown integration require an owner.

library.condition: Library service exists; baseline already contains these routes
library.status: see baseline rows; provider/store readiness still needs integration

stripe.status: isolated payments handler exists; legacy URL routing/handover remains R7/R10

conditionalMountReview.modes: Hosted baseline includes Stripe; self-host registration uses a closed handler. Native mode-specific registration sets are recorded separately; route names alone do not verify these policies.
